_comment: Provider-neutral integration registry. Existing MQTT_* and LOCAL_AI_* env vars remain supported; this file documents the normalized target shape for new integrations.

integrations._comment: Mapping registry is owned by the CPP repo (single source of truth); reference the sibling-repo copy rather than duplicating it here.
Native Apple app owns the CareKit store. PE receives pre-normalised task/outcome payloads only. Set CAREKIT_BRIDGE_TOKEN for shared-secret auth.
MCP gateway projecting RE/PE surfaces as MCP tools (see mcp/). Read-only by default; mutating tools are policy-gated and completions still flow back through PE source mappings.
